format:
  html:
    page-layout: full

Explore the 1-mile Diridon station area parcel by parcel. **Tracts** are shaded
by displacement-vulnerability score (renter share, rent burden, transit
dependence, and the City's Equity Index). **Parcels** that permit housing sit on
top — **coral** marks *soft sites* (underbuilt, high-capacity lots where new
homes can realistically go); grey marks already-built capacity parcels. Hover
any feature for its zoning, capacity, footprint coverage, and neighborhood
context. Toggle layers at top-right.

```{=html}
<iframe src="output/maps/diridon_interactive_map.html"
        style="width:100%; height:78vh; border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:6px;">
</iframe>
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
Sources: City of San José parcels, zoning, and Equity Index; ACS 2019–2023 5-year
estimates; OpenStreetMap building footprints. Capacity is theoretical zoned
capacity, not a production forecast — see [Methods & Sources](methods.qmd).
:::
